description: Change a series: name, brief, schedule, auto-post flags, the madeForKids answer or the AI motion level (motionMixLevel). Only the fields you pass change. Creating or changing a series is FREE. While active, the scheduler makes one video every scheduleIntervalDays (the first at its next run, within about 30 minutes) and charges each video like any video, at render — only when the balance covers it; a short balance skips that run, it never fails or overdraws. A series created or resumed through this connection counts each scheduled video against this key's daily agent spending cap (autoshort_get_limits); over the cap, that day's run is skipped.

autoPostFacebook.description: Publish each new video as a Reel on the connected Facebook Page.

autoPostInstagram.description: Publish each new video as a Reel on the connected Instagram account.

autoPostThreads.description: Publish each new video on the connected Threads profile.

motionMixLevel.description: AI motion: some scenes of every video are animated with Seedance, the rest stay images; each video is still a complete multi-scene video with voice and captions, never a single clip. Default NONE. Price per video at 30 s: NONE 40 credits per video; HOOK up to 80 credits per video (1 animated scene); HIGHLIGHTS up to 160 credits per video (3 animated scenes); CINEMATIC up to 240 credits per video (5 animated scenes). Animated scenes whose clip cannot start fall back to stills and are not charged. Accounts that have not paid yet can use only NONE or HOOK. If a run cannot afford or start the chosen level it makes the normal NONE video instead.
